label: GASP UEFN locomotion — lower-body 8-way + speed tiers
_note: Drives the LOWER half only (hips, legs). Upper body is owned by a separate layer + the IK pass that points the gun at the cursor. Direction selection: project velocity into body-relative space, pick the 8-way sector closest to it. Speed selection: idle / walk / run / sprint thresholds.
_adsNote: Each locomotion state has BOTH a hipfire clip (low-ready Pistol pose) and an ADS clip (shouldered Rifle pose). selectGaspLocomotion picks adsClip when playerState.adsAmount > 0.5. ADS sprint/back/diagonal coverage is partial — sectors without an ADS variant fall back to the hipfire clip via existing fallback logic.
_speedRefNote: speedRef is the planar speed at which the clip plays at timeScale 1.0. Raising speedRef makes the clip play SLOWER at the same actual speed (cadence drops). Lowering it makes the clip play FASTER. Directional bias: forward run feels frantic at 1:1 cadence so we raise its speedRef; backpedal + strafe feel sluggish (planted-foot mocap) so we lower theirs to push leg cadence faster.
_selectionNote: selectGaspLocomotion(playerState, planarSpeed, velocity, bodyYaw) in src/anim/locomotion.js implements: (a) speed bucket via thresholds.* (b) direction bucket via 8-way angle from velocity-vs-bodyYaw. (c) crouch override prefixes 'crouch_'. Returned state name then maps via this.states.
